articles.title: Cysic dangles a 10% bounty, hacker pours loot into Tornado Cash
articles.snippet: The attacker moved $744,000 in ETH and BNB to Tornado Cash after exploiting Cysic’s bridge to mint 10 million tokens on BNB Smart Chain.

articles.title: Bitcoin Core Rewrites Its Security Policy for a World Where AI Finds Bugs in One Prompt
articles.snippet: Developers will now backport fixes and cut releases immediately for flaws flagged as “easily discoverable,” abandoning long embargoes for bugs an attacker can surface with a single AI prompt.

articles.title: Is the Internet Safe Again After the PHP Nightmare? What You Need to Know
articles.snippet: PHP shipped its fix, attackers launched millions of attempts, and governments say no one has broken in yet. Here's what that means for your passwords, your crypto, and your browsing.

articles.title: Nvidia Unveils Its Full-Stack Blueprint to Contain and Monitor AI Agents
articles.snippet: Nvidia's OpenShell Reference Architecture pairs a software sandbox on Vera CPUs with Sentry monitoring on BlueField-4 chips, aiming to let companies run autonomous agents while enforcing limits agents cannot reach.

articles.title: PHP Panic: Two Critical Bugs Put 70% of the Internet at Risk, and Everyone Is Freaking Out
articles.snippet: Two critical bugs in PHP, the language running most of the web, let strangers take over servers without a password. The patch is out, attacks started early, and governments pulled the plug.
